facts.fact: Wacker 抱怨：四年前还在用的年度评估制度，如今想改回去却异常困难
facts.anchor: is how come it’s so hard for us to change back to an annual evaluation system we were using not even four years ago

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 解释：当初与供应商签约、陪着供应商把系统搭起来的那批 HR 人员全部升职走人
facts.anchor: the HR team that did the contracting with the vendor

facts.fact: Wacker 的助理在门口通报：香港的 Tad I. PI 打来保密电话
facts.anchor: I have a secure call for you from a Tad I. PI in Hong Kong.

facts.fact: 通话中 Wacker 放了个大号般的响屁，指着肚子无声口型说“肠易激综合征”
facts.anchor: Wacker let a tubaesque fart rip

facts.fact: Wacker 说前几天刚见过 MUCHADOO，谈的是新的 NOC 项目，并替 Tad 说了好话
facts.anchor: I met with DC/HR/DNCS MUCHADOO about the new NOC program just the other day

facts.fact: Wacker 请 Tad 留意即将途经当地的 KRAY，并说 KRAY 正替他做项目，好让 Hipsie 暂时别来烦他
facts.anchor: Pseudo’s KRAY, Andre B. KRAY. He’s handling a project for me, getting Hipsie off my back for a while.

facts.fact: 挂断保密电话后，Wacker 盯着刚才与旧友通话的那部电话，随后骂了一句
facts.anchor: He gazed at the telephone on which he had been talking to his old bud Tad I. PI.

facts.fact: 三人像一团蟾蜍似的起身，出门去参加早已开始的蛋糕派对
facts.anchor: They got up like a knot of toads and went out to join the cake party already in progress.
